title: In the Day of My Trouble I Seek the Lord

questions.question: I cry aloud to God, aloud to God, and he will do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:1 (ESV): "I cry aloud to God, aloud to God, and he will hear me."

questions.question: In the day of my trouble I seek whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:2 (ESV): "In the day of my trouble I seek the Lord;"

questions.question: In the night my hand is stretched out without wearying; my soul refuses to be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:2 (ESV): "...my soul refuses to be comforted."

questions.question: When I remember God, I moan; when I meditate, my spirit does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:3 (ESV): "...when I meditate, my spirit faints."

questions.question: You hold my eyelids open; I am so troubled that I cannot do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:4 (ESV): "You hold my eyelids open; I am so troubled that I cannot speak."

questions.question: I consider the days of old, the years long what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:5 (ESV): "I consider the days of old, the years long ago."

questions.question: Will the Lord spurn forever, and never again be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:7 (ESV): "Will the Lord spurn forever, and never again be favorable?"

questions.question: Has his steadfast love forever ceased? Are his promises at an end for all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:8 (ESV): "...Are his promises at an end for all time?"

questions.question: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he in anger shut up his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:9 (ESV): "Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he in anger shut up his compassion?"

questions.question: Then I said, "I will appeal to this, to the years of the right hand of the what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:10 (ESV): "...to the years of the right hand of the Most High."

questions.question: I will remember the deeds of the Lord; yes, I will remember your wonders of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:11 (ESV): "...yes, I will remember your wonders of old."

questions.question: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is great like our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:13 (ESV): "Your way, O God, is holy. What god is great like our God?"

questions.question: When the waters saw you, O God, when the waters saw you, they were afraid; indeed, the deep did what?
Your way was through the sea, your path through the great waters; yet your footprints were what?
You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 77:20 (ESV): "You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron."

key_verse_text: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is great like our God? You are the God who works wonders; you have made known your might among the peoples.
